name: Preserve the existing local school workspace
description: Verifies the Phase 1B storage abstraction preserves the existing school workspace across a reload.
steps: Open the existing school workspace
Refresh the application
Open the same school data section again
expected: The previously stored school data remains available after refresh and the application does not reset the workspace.

name: Filter Weekly Requirements by multiple data-hygiene dimensions
description: Verifies requirement review filters can be combined to isolate a precise subset of records and can be cleared.
steps: Open Weekly Requirements with multiple requirements present
Select a class, a subject, With doubles, and Active status together
Confirm only matching requirements remain visible
Change Status to All statuses and confirm inactive records can be reviewed
Use Clear filters
expected: Class, subject, double-lesson, and status filters work together; inactive requirements can be reviewed; Clear filters restores the default Active view and clears search text.

name: Configure and enforce generic teacher consecutive-single limits
description: Verifies the consecutive-single rule distinguishes overall teacher runs from consecutive singles assigned to the same class.
steps: Open Constraints and add a Hard Teacher consecutive single lessons rule for a selected teacher
Set maximum consecutive single lessons to 3 and maximum consecutive singles with the same class to 1
Generate a timetable with enough demand to require consecutive singles
Review the generated timetable and validation findings
expected: Up to three consecutive single lessons can be scheduled for the selected teacher when they serve different classes, while consecutive single lessons for the same class are limited to one.

name: Configure generic allowed lesson periods for subject placement
description: Verifies a subject placement rule can restrict lessons to selected lesson numbers without hard-coded subject or period names.
steps: Open Constraints and add a Hard Subject placement rule scoped to a selected subject
Enter allowed lesson numbers such as 4, 7, and 10
Generate the timetable
Review the subject's scheduled lesson numbers
expected: Every scheduled lesson for the targeted subject uses one of the configured allowed lesson numbers, while other subjects remain governed by their own rules.

name: Generate and independently validate division, doubles, and repair coverage
covers: configured doubles stay within shared segments when capacity allows
shared first period and independent second period
accurate unscheduled lesson counts across different days
weekly count uses day plus period ID
independent validator matches timetable grid coverage
description: Verifies the generic scheduler handles divisions, doubles, resources, ordinary requirements, and conflict-directed repair without duplicating displaced lessons or falsely reporting a lesson as unscheduled.
steps: Configure valid requirements and, where needed, a division with unequal weekly lesson counts and one configured double
Open Generate Timetable and run Quick Generate
Review scheduled periods, doubles, shared intervals, resource conflicts, validation findings, and any unscheduled requirement counts
If the bounded search uses repair, inspect the affected class timetable and compare its visible lesson periods with the requirement's scheduled count
expected: The scheduler respects configured demand, linked shared periods, double continuity, teachers, rooms, actual bell-schedule intervals, and independent validation; a repaired lesson exists only once in the final placement set, and weekly coverage counts each day-and-period occurrence separately even when a bell-schedule period ID repeats on another day; the generator, independent validator, and manual editor agree with the visible timetable grid; configured doubles are allocated within shared or independent segments whenever their capacities allow, and cross-boundary doubles are used only when required.

name: Manually repair a timetable with rule-aware drag and drop
covers: drag scheduled lesson to unscheduled tray
fully solved timetable saved as last valid
class teacher and room timetable presentation
combined class compact display on teacher timetable
combined class placement metadata and synchronized movement
numbered timetable pagination for classes teachers and rooms
jump directly to a timetable page
print all timetables in a category
one A4 landscape page per printed entity
compact division display without wider grid
description: Verifies users can manually move scheduled and unscheduled lessons while hard rules remain enforced and a fully solved result is persisted as valid.
steps: Generate a timetable that has at least one scheduled lesson and at least one unscheduled lesson
Drag a scheduled lesson to another grid cell and confirm the move is accepted only when validation passes
Drag a scheduled lesson into the Unscheduled lessons tray
Drag an unscheduled lesson into a valid grid location, or click it and click a destination cell
Attempt a conflicting move and confirm it is rejected
Resolve all remaining unscheduled lessons and confirm the result status becomes Complete
Refresh the page and load the last valid timetable
Open the timetable preview, switch between Classes, Teachers, and Rooms, and confirm each category shows numbered pages from 1 through the last entity
Click a non-first page number and confirm the corresponding class, teacher, or room timetable is shown
Use Print this page and confirm the selected timetable is printed as one A4 landscape page without pagination controls
Use Print all Classes, Print all Teachers, and Print all Rooms from their respective views and confirm each entity is printed on its own A4 landscape page
Use Next and Previous to move through the available entities
Confirm the selected entity name is prominent and the print preview shows the school logo area, centered school name, entity identity, and a single landscape timetable sheet
Review a class containing a division and confirm the division information remains inside the existing timetable cells without creating additional timetable columns
expected: Valid manual moves are saved as the working candidate; combined-class placements retain their group relationship after refresh, appear as one synchronized event on the teacher timetable with participating classes compacted into the same tile, and move to a new day/period or back to the tray as one group; unscheduled lessons can be placed into valid cells; conflicting moves are rejected with a reason; once all lessons are placed with zero hard violations the timetable is saved as the last valid timetable and remains loadable after refresh. The presentation supports separate class, teacher, and room views with sequential navigation, clearly identifies the current entity, prints a branded one-page landscape layout, and keeps division details compact within the same grid width.
